reviewSamples.author: Jennifer Holloway
reviewSamples.text: Ken and his team did an amazing job on my landscaping project. They added new sprinklers, sod, hedges, and executed on my vision. He was patience and responsive as I made several changes throughout project. I  absolutely love my yard. I will definitely hire him again.
